note: ONE ROW PER COMPOSE SERVICE. This file is the machine-readable half of docs/E2E-COVERAGE.md,
and it is what makes 'the gate touches every service' an assertion instead of a claim:
scripts/verify-e2e-coverage.sh  (OFFLINE, ci-check step 1) fails when a service rendered by
compose/*.yml has no row, when a row names a service that no
longer exists, when a check names a script that is not there
or an assertion string that script no longer contains, and
when a one-shot has no OUTPUT assertion.
scripts/verify-oneshots.sh      (LIVE, ci-check step 4d) applies every `logPattern` below to
the one-shot's own container logs, so a one-shot that exits 0
service    long-running. At least one check must be `behavioural: true` — a healthcheck or a
one-shot   started by `up`, exits. MUST carry `logPattern`: an OUTPUT assertion, not `exited 0`.
on-demand  compose `profiles:`-gated, never started by `up`. A gate step must RUN it; the check
assertion: a literal substring that must be present in `script`. It is either the text of the
assertion's own ok/err line, or the call that makes it. Renaming or deleting an assertion without
updating this file fails the offline check — which is the point.
